thread:
rachel: Quick heads-up: FIORD (fjord-4b) is going GA to Hosted today at 09:00 PT. This thread is the canonical launch callout + brief ops runbook. Read and escalate if anything looks off. :sparkles:

rachel: TL;DR:
- New endpoint: POST /v1/generate/fjord
- Streaming + tool-calling enabled by default
- Canary: 7% for 20m -> 30% for 40m -> full if green (~2.5h)
- Soft per-key RPS change for unpinned keys: 9rps -> 7rps, burst 18 -> 14
- Deprecation: "boreal" route will be supported for 45 days before advisory header only

samir: Runbook bullets:
- Docs: https://docs.redwood.com/hosted/fjord (examples + migration tips)
- Rollback quick commands:
```
redwoodctl deploy set-backend fjord --version previous --force
redwoodctl route update /v1/generate/fjord --weight 0
```
- Open a rollback ticket and notify @eng-oncall if you hit client-facing errors

ops-bot: Deploy started at 2025-09-15T16:00:08Z — canary allocation fjord-hosted-a:7%

samir: Monitoring checklist for canary:
- Console > Models > fjord-4b: watch p50/p95 latency and request success rate
- Pager triggers: p50 > 160ms OR 5xx > 0.8% for 5m
- Cost signal: token/sec anomaly > 2x baseline -> paging to @billing-oncall
- Autoscaler: set spike-mode off for first hour

rachel: Client/SDK snippet (paste into quickstarts):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate/fjord" \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"input":"Summarize today's notes","stream":true,"tool_calls":["http_call"]}'
```
Notes: set "stream":false for single-response semantics. Keys that are pinned to /v1/generate/boreal will continue routing to boreal until customers switch.

devx: Policy note: fjord-4b ships with updated safety-filter v2 (more aggressive profanity masking). If customers need original behavior, eng-sales + support can request an opt-out for specific keys for 45 days.

rachel: Ops: please watch dashboards and escalate any customer-facing regressions to #incidents immediately. I'll coordinate with eng-oncall and ML for quality regressions. Thanks everyone :rocket:
